utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help with a few repairs, as long as we keep it organized. Just let me know the timing and where people should drop things off—my place works best if that’s an option.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That works for me—your place can be the drop-off. Just let me know the timing and I’ll point people there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — once you’ve got the timing set, I can take a few repairs as long as they’re labeled clearly.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m pretty sure it’s the real deal — I saw the boxes and labels myself, so it’s more than just looking busy. If you want, I can swing by and see what’s still left to do.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’d be great, Tess — thanks! I’ll spread the word and send the timing and drop-off details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if I hear what’s left on the list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: The latest is we’re aiming for a 3:30 to 5:30 window so folks can stop by after pickup, and I’m checking in with the Maple and Pine block captains first. I’m also still waiting on Mara’s flyer details to help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That makes sense—thanks for the update. If you get Mara’s flyer details, I’d be happy to help spread the word too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep reminding folks and make sure the details get around.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — that helps a lot. I’m a bit behind, but I’ll catch up and help keep it low-key.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind everyone what to bring. We’ll keep it low-key and make it easy for folks to jump in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, so I don’t want to guess yet. I’ll confirm whether the repair drive has started and how the donations are going.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it—just let me know when you’ve confirmed it, and I’ll help with sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo—I’ll verify the status and donation progress, then I’ll let you know so we can handle sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ve got the list and sign-up sheet started, and I’ll send out a clear update by Friday. Kira, if you tell me what skills or supplies you can bring, I’ll slot you in where it’s most useful.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm exactly what you need from me and where the drop-off is? I’m not signing up until I know it’s set for real.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll confirm the final list, drop-off spot, and time before I ask anyone to sign up. I’ll send you the details as soon as it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community center front steps at 10:00 and I’ll bring the route plan. Just let me know what supplies you’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll bring some boxes, labels, and a marker for sorting. See you at the front steps at 10:00.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great, Sam — that covers it. I’ll have the route plan ready and see you at the front steps at 10:00.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That window should work—I’ll check the school pickup timing and make sure we can keep it open from 3:30 to 5:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you also tell me whether the repair drive has started, or are donations still coming in?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m not sure it’s fully started yet — last I heard donations were still coming in, but it’s getting close. I’ll check and let you know what’s set up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly tools, spare parts, and any small appliances that still have a little life in them. I’m trying to remember the exact list, but that’s the gist of it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—tools, spare parts, and small appliances. I’ll meet you at the community center front steps at 10:00.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Perfect, 10:00 at the community center front steps sounds good to me. I’ll bring what I can and see you there.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m still checking while I’m out, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate you keeping an eye out. I’ll try not to miss the update this time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll keep watching for it while I’m out, and I’ll pass it along as soon as I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking our supplies now, Mara, and I’ll tell you what we’re short on. Once I’ve got the list, I can point folks to the first repair job.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — send me the short list when you’re ready, and I’ll help point people to the first repair job.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Will do — I’ll finish the supply check and send you the short list shortly.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Leo — just send me the list of tools you still need, and I’ll see what I can lend for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — I’ll send the tool list over right away.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — I’m happy to help with whatever you still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m on it — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks what to bring for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Vik — that’s a big help. I’ll share the sign-up sheet and the needed fixes list, and we can keep folks posted from there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect — I’ll keep reminding everyone and make sure the repair-drive details get around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — I’ll be at the community center front steps at 10:00, and I’ll bring the route map.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, that works for me—10:00 at the community center front steps is clear. Just let me know how many repairs you’re expecting so I can keep mine manageable.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m expecting a small, manageable set of repairs—just enough to keep the route moving smoothly. I’ll confirm the exact list before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive, but I’d like to keep my part quiet. Just let me know where I’m needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds great—thanks, Uli. I’m still catching up, so if you hear where help’s needed, please point me to the list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Of course — I’ll keep it low-key and send you the list when I see it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Saturday morning works for me — I can bring some supplies, and you can map the route. Just remind me of the exact list if I forget again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the exact list, Oren? I just want to make sure we’re actually set for Saturday and not missing anything.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Mostly tools, spare parts, and any small appliances that still work a little. If I’m missing anything, just remind me and I’ll double-check.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — keep me posted when you find out.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what needs fixing and where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey — that works for me.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll check in with the Maple and Pine block captains first and keep an eye out for your flyer details.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. I’m out running errands now, so I’ll keep an eye out too and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Ira — I’ll touch base with the captains and loop you in as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — I can lend a hand and bring over any tools we need for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s wonderful, Gus — we’re collecting basics like tape, screws, glue, and a few small tools. I’ll send you the full list and drop-off details right after this.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Mara — send the list when you’re ready, and I’ll round up what I can. Happy to help get the repair drive set up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking the supplies now, and I’ll let you know what’s still missing so we can get started.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks—can you tell me if the repair drive has started yet, and what donations are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Not quite yet—we’re still getting everything together. I’m checking what’s on hand now, and I’ll tell you what donations we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll be at the community center front steps at 10:00.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, I’ll meet you there and see what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect—see you at the community center front steps at 10:00.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate you keeping me posted. I’ll do my best to bring what I can and not miss the details.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Of course — I’ll keep you posted as soon as I have the time and drop-off spot. If you want, I can also invite a few more neighbors to help out.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: That’d be great, Quinn — thanks. I’ll do my best to keep up and bring whatever I can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donated items and set them by category.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks — that’ll make things much smoother. I’ll keep the 3:30 to 5:30 window in mind around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll have everything sorted and ready before pickup.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late again — once Cleo’s done checking supplies, I’ll help fill in whatever’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll wait for Cleo’s supply check before I say more. If you can send the current list, I can confirm what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sure — I’ll send the current list as soon as Cleo finishes, and then we can fill in the gaps quietly.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
